notes_extra: 230gr OTM. COAL 3.813, .020 off. He topped a pressure test at this charge and saw no pressure. He called the test pretty flat from 87.2-88.2 gr and again around 90.2-91.2 gr, same hole at 100 yards. He named nodes at 2,920, 2,980, and 3,000 fps and did not tie them to one charge.
